caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, hollow object resembling a ring or torus, with a small, narrow neck and opening at the top. The object is predominantly brown, featuring alternating wavy lines of color that wrap horizontally around its circular body. These wavy lines include darker brown, light brown, white, and a blue-green shade. The interior of the ring is left open, showing the background. The background itself is off-white or beige in color, and the overall composition centers the ring-shaped object on the page. At the lower part of the image, there is a small measurement scale with numerals "0", "1", "2", and the word "inches" labeled below the lines. The edges of the drawing are slightly darker, suggesting an aged paper texture.
title: Ring Bottle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
